result.instructions: Tools for MRPeasy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which stock items are at or below their minimum quantity right now?"; "Show me the open customer orders for next week and what is still not booked."; "List the purchase orders waiting for delivery from our top vendors.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MRPeasy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mrpeasy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mrpeasy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mrpeasy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. mrpeasy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: List the sites (warehouses and production locations) in the MRPeasy account. Uses GET /sites.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_site
tools.title: Get a site
tools.description: Get one site by id. Uses GET /sites/{site_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers, with optional filters on code, title, contact details and creation date. Uses GET /customers.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Uses GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_customer_orders
tools.title: List customer orders
tools.description: List customer orders (sales orders), with optional filters on code, customer, dates and product. Uses GET /customer-orders.

product_code.description: Filter by the code of an ordered stock item.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_customer_order
tools.title: Get a customer order
tools.description: Get one customer order by id, with its lines. Uses GET /customer-orders/{customer_order_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_sales_invoices
tools.title: List sales invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices, with optional filters on code, customer, order and dates. Uses GET /invoices.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_sales_invoice
tools.title: Get a sales invoice
tools.description: Get one sales invoice by id. Uses GET /invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_stock_items
tools.title: List stock items
tools.description: List stock items (products, materials and semi-finished goods), with optional filters on code, title, group and barcode. Uses GET /items.

vendor_code.description: Filter by the code of the main vendor.

is_raw.description: Only raw materials (true) or only non-raw items (false).

is_inventory.description: Only inventory items (true) or only non-inventory items (false).

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_stock_item
tools.title: Get a stock item
tools.description: Get one stock item by product id, with its variations. Uses GET /items/{product_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_inventory
tools.title: List inventory
tools.description: List on-hand inventory per stock item, as of a date (UNIX timestamp; default today). Uses GET /inventory.

date.description: Inventory date as a UNIX timestamp; quantities are as of the end of that day.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_inventory_item
tools.title: Get inventory of a stock item
tools.description: Get the on-hand inventory of one stock item by article id, optionally for one date and site. Uses GET /inventory/{article_id}.

date.description: Inventory date as a UNIX timestamp; default today.

annotations.title: Get inventory of a stock item

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_critical_inventory
tools.title: List critical on-hand stock
tools.description: List stock items on the critical on-hand report (stock at or below the minimum quantity set in MRPeasy). Uses GET /inventory/critical.

is_raw.description: Only raw materials (true) or only non-raw items (false).

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_boms
tools.title: List bills of materials
tools.description: List bills of materials (BOMs), with optional filters on code, title and the product they make. Uses GET /boms.

product_code.description: Filter by the code of the product the BOM makes.

product_title.description: Filter by the title of the product the BOM makes.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_bom
tools.title: Get a bill of materials
tools.description: Get one bill of materials by id, with its components. Uses GET /boms/{bom_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_manufacturing_orders
tools.title: List manufacturing orders
tools.description: List manufacturing orders (production orders), with optional filters on code, product, customer order and dates. Uses GET /manufacturing-orders.

product_code.description: Filter by the code of the product made.

product_title.description: Filter by the title of the product made.

customer_order_code.description: Filter by the code of the linked customer order.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_manufacturing_order
tools.title: Get a manufacturing order
tools.description: Get one manufacturing order by id, with its operations and parts. Uses GET /manufacturing-orders/{manufacturing_order_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: List purchase orders, with optional filters on code, vendor, dates and free text. Uses GET /purchase-orders.

order_number.description: Filter by the vendor order number.

invoice_number.description: Filter by the vendor invoice number.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get a purchase order
tools.description: Get one purchase order by id, with its lines. Uses GET /purchase-orders/{purchase_order_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_vendors
tools.title: List vendors
tools.description: List vendors (suppliers), with optional filters on code, name and contact details. Uses GET /vendors.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_vendor
tools.title: Get a vendor
tools.description: Get one vendor by id. Uses GET /vendors/{vendor_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: List shipments, with optional filters on code, linked order, tracking number and dates. Uses GET /shipments.

company_title.description: Filter by the company name on the shipment.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_shipment
tools.title: Get a shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment by id. Uses GET /shipments/{shipment_id}.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with MRPeasy
prompts.description: What you can do with MRPeasy here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: spot_stock_at_or_below_its_minimum
prompts.title: Spot stock at or below its minimum
prompts.description: List the critical on-hand stock report and the on-hand inventory per stock item. Open one stock item to see its variations.

prompts.name: follow_customer_orders_and_sales_invoices
prompts.title: Follow customer orders and sales invoices
prompts.description: List customer orders with filters on customer and dates, and open one to see its lines. Check the sales invoices for the same customer.

prompts.name: track_purchase_orders_from_vendors
prompts.title: Track purchase orders from vendors
prompts.description: List purchase orders with filters on vendor and dates, and open one to see its lines. Read the vendor record for the contact details.

prompts.name: review_manufacturing_orders_and_their_bills_of_materials
prompts.title: Review manufacturing orders and their bills of materials
prompts.description: List manufacturing orders by product, customer order or dates. Open one to see its operations and parts, and read the bill of materials for the product.

prompts.name: trace_shipments_to_their_orders
prompts.title: Trace shipments to their orders
prompts.description: List shipments by linked order, tracking number or dates. Open one shipment to see its details.
